TRAJECTORY (corrected metric): iter-1 OOM(bs4); iter-2 0.8012 hr0; iter-3 0.7932 hr0 (lambda 0.0023->0.05 UP REGRESSED); iter-4 0.7828 hr0 (n_filters 16->4 DOWN REGRESSED); iter-5 0.8114 hr0.0319 KEEP (epochs 14->19 UP, FIRST above the ~0.84 LD-FBP floor); iter-6 0.7883 hr0 DISCARD (lr 5e-4->3e-4 DOWN REGRESSED); iter-7 0.8170 hr0.0375 KEEP (batch_size 2->1 DOWN, NEW BEST); iter-8 0.7935 hr0 DISCARD (vn_T 5->2 depth-down REGRESSED -- NOT the breakout axis). best hr=0.0375 @iter-7. rationale: itnet_v3-claude-agentic: itnet_k=2, unet_c=16, alpha_init=0.0037, lr=0.0001, epochs=9, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=460, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=720, seed=42, rationale=iter-9 (search-20260619-01, corrected protocol). BASE_ITER=7 (the BEST: itnet_k=3/unet_c=16/alpha_init=0.0037/lr=1e-4/epochs=9/train_n=460/grad_clip=1.0/seed=42, hr 0.336607 / SSIM 0.915241). ONE KNOB: itnet_k 3 to 2 (number of unrolled denoise+DC steps). GENUINELY-UNTRIED architectural knob -- itnet_k pinned at 3 for all 8 iters; data-coverage (train_n 200->460->579), epochs (8->18, plateaued), capacity (unet_c 16->24, regressed) are exhausted, lr is OFF-LIMITS (v3 lr-FRAGILE: lr3e-4 historically COLLAPSED it). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS). (1) TRAJECTORY: iter-1 ep8/tn200/k3 hr 0.268409; iter-2 ep14 0.310054; iter-3 ep18 0.312282 (epochs PLATEAUED +0.0022, SSIM dropped); iter-4 c24/ep9 0.295576 (capacity REGRESSED -> revert c16); iter-5 ep9/tn400 0.328842 (+0.0165 DATA lever); iter-6 ep6/tn579 0.315239 (full data but exposure cut to 6x -> REGRESSED); iter-7 BEST ep9/tn460 hr 0.336607 / SSIM 0.915241 / elapsed 1139.1s (coverage-at-9x-exposure, +0.0078); iter-8 ep7/tn579 0.314928 (full data at 7x still under-trains -> data-coverage EXHAUSTED in-budget; v3 needs >=8-9x exposure full data cannot afford). MAPPED: epochs (plateaued), unet_c (regressed), train_n (best 460), lr (off-limits/fragile), grad_clip (mandatory=1.0). UNTRIED: itnet_k (always 3), alpha_init (always 0.0037), seed (always 42). (2) LIMITER: data-coverage EXHAUSTED in-budget (iter-8 falsifier fired -- full data under-trains at the affordable 7x); the architectural DC-step count itnet_k is the most load-bearing untried knob, and CROSS-SOLVER evidence is strong: itnet v1 (the current Mayo #1 at hr 0.434) won at itnet_k=1 -- fewer DC steps win on noisy LDCT (campaign-state note). v3 has never moved off k=3. (3) ONE KNOB: itnet_k 3 to 2 (single clean step down from the proven k=3 basin -- NOT a 3->1 jump; v3 is fragile and a 2-step architectural change risks collapse like the lr/capacity moves). All else = iter-7 best EXACTLY (unet_c=16, alpha_init=0.0037, lr=1e-4, epochs=9, train_n=460, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42); epochs HELD at 9 (NOT traded up) to keep a clean single-knob read -- the ~220s freed by the cheaper k=2 stack is left under-wall on purpose so the falsifier isolates the k-effect, not extra optimization (if k=2 wins, iter-10 banks the freed budget as epochs). (4) HYPOTHESIS: cutting the unrolled DC count 3 to 2 lifts hr above the iter-7 best 0.336607, because on noisy dense-view LDCT each 2304-view FBP-adjoint DC step re-injects measurement noise (the LD sinogram is the noise source), so fewer DC steps = less noise re-injection = cleaner recon -- the mechanism that made itnet v1 champion at k=1. NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if hr <= 0.336607 at k=2/ep9/tn460, the v1 fewer-DC-steps-win result does NOT transfer to the v3 end-to-end variant (v3 learned-alpha already balances DC re-injection, or k=3 is needed for the end-to-end gradient path) -> itnet_k lever exhausted for v3, iter-10 tries alpha_init or seed (the last two untried knobs); 0.3366 stands as v3 budget-constrained ceiling. (5) BUDGET (HARD 1200s = train+score): forward() runs k iterations of denoise+dc_step, dc_step is a full 2304-view forward-project + FBP, so per-slice train cost scales ~ with k. From iter-7 (k3/tn460/ep9 -> 1139.1s): fixed 481s + 9*460*per_slice => per_slice_k3 = 0.1590 s/slice; per-k unit = 0.0530 s. At k=2: per_slice = 0.1060 s -> ep9/tn460 = 481 + 9*460*0.1060 = 920s = 15.3 min < 1200s with ~280s headroom. Train-only at ep9 = 439s; max_train_s=720 safe backstop (never truncates -- checks between epochs, fences only runaway slowdown); the 214-slice per-sample val + figure always land inside the 30-min sbatch wall. val=ALL 214 L277 slices, 321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; no fov= override). lr HELD at 1e-4 (v3 lr-FRAGILE -- do NOT touch). grad_clip=1.0 retained (mandatory: 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint inside dc_step overflows otherwise). HARD-WIRED (unchanged): staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps FBP init + per-sample itnet.projector swap for the k DC steps, bg_target=truth. (6) do NOT return control mid-campaign. Predicted iter-9 hr: 0.34-0.35 if fewer-DC-steps-win transfers from v1; <=0.3366 falsifies -> itnet_k lever exhausted for v3, iter-10 tries alpha_init/seed.

ONE KNOB (CAPACITY re-probe at the now-WORKING shallow depth): vn_n_filters 16 -> 24. BASE = iter-7 (the BREAKOUT + run-BEST: vn_T=2, vn_n_filters=16, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, vn_normalize_filters=False, train_n=480, lr=5e-4, batch_size=2, vn_checkpoint=true, grad_clip=1.0, vn_dc_norm=true, vn_init=fbp). DEPTH IS NOW SETTLED: iter-7 vn_T 5->2 BROKE OUT to SSIM 0.86068 hr 0.154039 (#8 on board); iter-8 vn_T 2->1 REGRESSED to SSIM 0.84581 hr 0.11827 (a single DC step under-powers) -> vn_T=2 IS the unroll-depth optimum (T=8 crashed to 0.667, T=1 under-powers, T=2 wins). KEEP vn_T=2. TRAJECTORY (NUMBERS): iter-1 SSIM 0.80528 (vn_T=5,N_k=16,lam=0.0023,hr0); iter-2 SSIM 0.79195 (N_k 16->24 capacity^ REGRESSED -0.0133, hr0); iter-3 SSIM 0.76820 (lam^ REGRESSED, hr0); iter-4 SSIM 0.73363 (normalize_filters T REGRESSED, hr0); iter-5 SSIM 0.80886 (train_n 200->480 +0.0036, hr0); iter-6 SSIM 0.66729 (vn_T 5->8 REGRESSED -0.142, hr0); iter-7 SSIM 0.86068 hr 0.154039 PSNR 35.53 elapsed 971.2s (vn_T 5->2 BREAKOUT) <- BEST, current N_k=16, train_n=480; iter-8 SSIM 0.84581 hr 0.11827 elapsed 452.3s (vn_T 2->1 REGRESSED). LIMITER / KEY INSIGHT: capacity (vn_n_filters^) AND data (train_n^) were BOTH falsified at the OLD noisy OVER-UNROLLED vn_T=5 regime and have NEVER been tested at the now-working shallow vn_T=2 depth -- the iter-8 falsifier explicitly flagged this as the next move. CHOICE OF KNOB (capacity over data, from NUMBERS): at vn_T=5 vn_n_filters 16->24 REGRESSED -0.0133 (iter-2) while train_n 200->480 gave only +0.0036 (iter-5, near-saturated at 480/579). At vn_T=5 the learned regulariser was a BLUNT over-smoother re-injected 5x via the in-loop projector DC step, so MORE filters made the smoother WORSE; at the clean vn_T=2 denoiser-dominant regime the recon is no longer smoother-bound, so a richer 24-filter bank has headroom to express an EDGE-PRESERVING regulariser instead of collapsing to smoothing. train_n is already near data-saturation (480/579, +0.0036 at full) so capacity is the higher-value re-probe. KEEP train_n=480. MECHANISM: vn_n_filters 16->24 (the solver default capacity) gives the learned filter bank K_i more degrees of freedom; at the working shallow depth where the denoiser shows through, the extra filters can preserve structure/contrast rather than the DC-smoothing they collapsed to at vn_T=5. HYPOTHESIS: with 24 filters at the working vn_T=2 depth, val_ssim rises above the iter-7 BEST 0.86068 and hr clears 0.154039 (the capacity lever falsified-at-vn_T=5 now helps at the shallow depth). FALSIFIER (numeric): if val_ssim <= 0.86068 / hr <= 0.154039 at vn_T=2 with 24 filters, capacity does NOT transfer to the shallow regime either -- 16 filters is the optimum at all depths -- and iter-10 should re-probe the LAST untested data lever (train_n 480->579, full pool) at vn_T=2. BUDGET (HARD 20-min/1200s train+score; sbatch --time=00:30:00): vn_n_filters 16->24 = ~1.4x per-step RBF/conv cost; iter-7 ran 971.2s total at N_k=16/vn_T=2/train_n=480, so max_train_s=1000 still BINDS the train wall (fewer epochs fit but still past the ep3 convergence point -> fair converged comparison; cf. iter-2 ran N_k=24 fine at 1351s). val_n=214 kept. Total ~= 1000 (train wall) + ~160 (score 214 + figure) ~= 1160s, under the 1800s SLURM kill (>600s margin). MEMORY-SAFE: vn_T=2 x N_k=24 with batch_size=2 + vn_checkpoint=true stays within the 16 GB RTX5000 (iter-2/3/4 all ran N_k=24 at vn_T=5 with no OOM; vn_T=2 is a LIGHTER footprint -- fewer unrolled steps -> less activation memory; far from the hammernik_2017 bs=4 OOM at 72s). grad_clip=1.0 + vn_dc_norm=true retained (VN-family NaN-skip stability; the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint overflows the backward otherwise).

BASE_ITER=2 BEST (proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, 12 params, hr 0.028237, ep24). ONE KNOB: proj_sr 0.0005->0.0001 (5x TIGHTER = edge-preserving in the PROJECTION domain -- the campaign-state-named, substrate-specific, headroom-aligned lever that has NEVER been moved on this run). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, hr=metric of record): (1) TRAJECTORY: iter-1 hr 0.027984 ep8; iter-2 hr 0.028237 ep24 = BEST (epochs INERT); iter-3 hr 0.0 img_n_bf=6 (image capacity DESTABILIZED); iter-4 hr 0.028237 proj_n_bf=2 (proj-DEPTH FLAT); iter-5 hr 0.009801 train_n=480 (DATA REGRESSED -- too small to exploit data); iter-6 hr 0.021479 lr=0.001 (lr-DOWN REGRESSED); iter-7 hr 0.028192 img_sr=0.005 (image range-sigma FLAT/INERT). MAPPED knobs: epochs, img_n_bf, proj_n_bf, train_n, lr, img_sr -- all spent. (2) LIMITER: NOT yet a pure structural ceiling -- one named, headroom-aligned scalar is genuinely UNTRIED. The campaign-state doc (mayo_campaign_state.md L212): >>Mayo (2304-view) -- the IMAGE-domain sigma is inert and proj_sr-DOWN is the lever<<. iter-7 just CONFIRMED the image-domain img_sr is inert on Mayo (0.02->0.005 flat 0.0282), exactly as the doc predicts -- which elevates proj_sr-DOWN from candidate to THE clean falsifier. proj_sr has been FROZEN at 0.0005 for all 7 iters; it is an INIT but the supervised MSE does NOT free it as a trainable DOF the way img_sr is (the projection-domain BF range-sigma controls how much CORRELATED sinogram noise is smoothed BEFORE the 2304-view FBP adjoint amplifies it -- a pre-FBP locus the image-domain knobs cannot reach). (3) ONE KNOB = proj_sr 0.0005->0.0001 (5x DOWN). JUSTIFICATION vs the other untried scalars (proj_sx/proj_sy spatial sigmas, proj_kernel, seed, lambda_neg, grad_clip): proj_sr-DOWN is the ONE the campaign-state doc explicitly names as THE Mayo bilateral lever and aligns with the RMSE-sensitive headroom direction (tighter range-sigma = LESS smoothing = edge-preserving = the headroom-favored direction, since SSIM rewards blur but hr penalizes it). The spatial sigmas / kernel / seed are unmapped but NOT doc-flagged; proj_sr is the highest-value single shot. (4) HYPOTHESIS: proj_sr 0.0005->0.0001 lifts hr above 0.028237 because a tighter projection-domain range-sigma makes the pre-FBP sinogram bilateral edge-preserving rather than blurring, letting the RMSE-driven supervised-MSE recover sharper structure that the 321px-FOV headroom metric credits -- the exact image-domain analogue (img_sr-down) was just shown inert, but the doc says the PROJECTION domain is where the Mayo lever lives. NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if hr stays <=0.030 (flat) OR regresses at proj_sr=0.0001, the LAST doc-named headroom-aligned scalar is exhausted -> FILE THE STRUCTURAL-CEILING VERDICT: hr~0.028 is the 12-param trainable-bilateral structural ceiling on real 2304-view Mayo LDCT, confirmed-robust across epochs, BOTH-domain capacity, data-coverage, learning-rate, image-domain range-sigma, AND the doc-named projection-domain range-sigma -- no within-architecture scalar escapes it; remaining iters toward iter-20 are pure confirmations (proj_sx/proj_sy/seed). OFF iter-1 base (best-PSNR config: lr 5e-3, img_n_bf 1, proj_n_bf 1, proj_sr 0.02, proj_kernel 5 -- the untouched warm-start-anchored baseline; proj_n_bf REVERTED from iter-7 s 3 to 1 so this is genuinely ONE knob vs iter-1). (1) TRAJECTORY: iter-1 lr5e-3 proj_sr0.02 proj_n_bf1 proj_kernel5 -> SSIM 0.92477 / PSNR 34.033 / RMSE 9.938e-4 / hr 0 / 940.4s; iter-2 proj_sr0.02->0.0005 -> SSIM 0.92473 / hr 0 (proj_sr range INERT, RETIRED); iter-3 lr5e-3->3e-4 -> SSIM 0.92142 / hr 0 (lr-down REGRESSED); iter-4 img_n_bf1->2 -> SSIM 0.89748 / hr 0 (image-domain depth REGRESSED hard); iter-5 proj_n_bf1->2 -> SSIM 0.92468 / hr 0 (proj-depth +1 mild regress); iter-6 proj_kernel5->7 -> SSIM 0.924766 / hr 0 (proj spatial FOOTPRINT-EXTENT flat); iter-7 proj_n_bf1->3 -> SSIM 0.925289 / PSNR 34.097 / RMSE 9.865e-4 / hr 0 / 1129.1s (marginal best, proj-depth saturated). Best hr 0.0 throughout. (2) LIMITER = 6-param trainable-bilateral CAPACITY CEILING on dense-view 2304-view Mayo: HIGHEST raw SSIM of any Mayo inference solver (0.925) yet PSNR sits BELOW the LD-FBP floor -> hr 0 (over-smoothing signature). rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=4, n_iter=18, grad_clip=1.0, unet_c=24, lr=0.0003, batch_size=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, outer_wall_s=1300, per_scene_s=None, seed=42, rationale=dual_domain_n2i iter-8 (search-20260619-01, PER-IMAGE Noise2Inverse: warm-start pre-pass + per-scan Adam fit; NEVER amortized). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, from iter-1..7 observations). (1) TRAJECTORY both per-scan levers + warm-start depth now MAPPED with bracketed interior optima: lr {1e-3 hr0 (drift), 3e-4 hr0.1976 BEST, 1.5e-4 hr0.1207 iter-6 REGRESSED} optimum 3e-4; n_iter {15 hr0.1506, 18 hr0.1976 BEST, 20 hr0.1595 iter-5 REGRESSED} optimum 18; pretrain_epochs {1 hr0, 4 hr0.1976 BEST, 6 hr0.1870 iter-7 REGRESSED} optimum 4. iter-4 (pe4,n18,lr3e-4,unet_c16) hr 0.1976 SSIM 0.9277 PSNR 35.99 RMSE 7.934e-4 elapsed 1235.5s is the joint optimum + run best (BASE_ITER=4). (2) LIMITER: all three scalar levers (lr, n_iter, pretrain_epochs) are spent/wrong-signed at their bracketed optima. The half-view info bound is the leading hypothesis, BUT one genuinely-untried single knob remains: per-scan U-Net CAPACITY at the now-anchored lr. unet_c has been HELD at 16 for ALL 7 corrected-campaign iters; the only c16->c32 datapoint (campaign-state note: flat at 0.9508) is from the DISCARDED boundary-slice run AND was at lr=1e-3 -- the DRIFT regime where the per-scan fit leaves the init, so capacity could not carry through (same confound that made iter-2 pretrain_epochs-up misread). Capacity has NEVER been tested at the anchored lr=3e-4/n_iter=18 optimum where the fit refines NEAR the FBP-consistent init. (3) ONE KNOB: unet_c 16 -> 24 (lr=3e-4, n_iter=18, pretrain_epochs=4, grad_clip=1.0, warm_start=True, val_n=214, seed=42 ALL HELD at iter-4 BEST; the 2-subset even/odd angular split is hard-wired in geometry.py::split_angles and is NOT a cfg knob, so it cannot be the lever without editing a shared module -- forbidden). outer_wall_s 1080 -> 1300 is a FORCED anti-truncation consequence of the larger net (not a tuning knob): the per-scene fit time rises with capacity, and at outer_wall_s=1080 per_scene_s=5.05s with only 0.45s margin over the c16 4.60s/scene would silently truncate; 1300 gives per_scene_s=6.07s, comfortably above the expected ~5.5s/scene at c24, so ALL 214 scenes complete 18 steps with NO truncation. (4) HYPOTHESIS: unet_c 16->24 at the anchored lr=3e-4/n_iter=18 optimum lifts hr above 0.1976 (PSNR above 35.99) because a higher-capacity per-scan denoiser carries a richer FBP-consistent prior through the 18-step refine (lr anchors it near the init; this is the refine regime, not drift). NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if hr <= 0.1976 (no PSNR gain over 35.99), per-scan capacity is NOT the binding constraint at the anchored lr and per-image U-Net N2I ceilings at hr~0.20 on dense 2304-view Mayo -- the half-view info-loss bound (the even/odd split discards half the 2304 views) -> hr 0.1976 @iter-4 is the per-image N2I half-view ceiling; document it (NAF/ram structural-negative class), no further per-image tuning. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20-min compute, val=ALL 214): unet_c adds U-Net forward/backward per step; the per-step wall is dominated by the c-INDEPENDENT 2304-view FBP forward+adjoint, so the c16->c24 increase is a fraction of each step. Conservative +20% on the c16 fit loop: 985s -> ~1182s; + overhead ~267s (warm-start 4ep + setup/score) = ~1449s compute; + figure ~27s = ~1476s = 24.6 min figure-inclusive, 324s (5.4 min) under the 1800s/30-min SLURM hard wall. Fit loop ~1182s < outer_wall_s=1300 backstop; per-scene ~5.5s < per_scene_s=1300/214=6.07s -> NO truncation. grad_clip=1.0 mandatory (2304-view FBP adjoint overflows otherwise). val_n=214 NOT reduced (protocol). 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov=False). staged_canonical / v3 mayo_ldct_fitted / per-sample-ps half-angle projector swap / bg_target=truth hard-wired. PER-IMAGE structure UNCHANGED (warm-start pre-pass + per-scan fit; NEVER amortized). (6) no control return.

(1) TRAJECTORY iter->hr: 1->0.0508 (lr0.01,ep6,8params,335s), 2(ep18@lr0.01)->0.0337 (epochs INERT AT lr0.01, hr FELL), 3(n_bands6)->0.0, 4(n_outer2)->0.0 (SSIM 0.6459 COLLAPSED), 5(train_n480,ep3)->0.0411 (data FAILED), 6(lr 0.01->0.003,ep6)->0.0966 NEW BEST (SSIM 0.8232, 334.8s), 7(lr 0.003->0.001,ep6)->0.0668 REGRESSED (SSIM 0.8022, 350.4s). THE lr/EPOCHS INTERACTION: lr0.01->0.003 nearly DOUBLED hr (0.0508->0.0966), but the further drop lr0.003->0.001 at the SAME ep6 REGRESSED to 0.0668 -- at ep6 the smaller lr0.001 UNDER-CONVERGED, it did not reach the basin lr0.003 found in 6 steps. Base copied = iter-7 (lr0.001). (2) LIMITER: the lr0.001 basin is UNDER-CONVERGED at ep6 -- iter-7 fired its own falsifier (hr 0.0668 <= 0.0966 at lr0.001/ep6 => RAISE EPOCHS to let the smaller lr converge BEFORE declaring the lr axis exhausted; do NOT yet file the FBP-ceiling verdict). (3) ONE KNOB: epochs 6 -> 18 (3x) AT lr0.001 (iter-7 base, UNCHANGED). Sole change. PARAM COUNT UNCHANGED at 8 (wu_n_bands=4 + 2 + 2*wu_n_outer=1). wu_n_outer=1 (MANDATORY), grad_clip=1.0, wu_n_bands=4 all held. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if iter-7 was lr0.001-UNDER-CONVERGENCE-limited at ep6, giving it 18 epochs lets lr0.001 settle into a basin that lifts hr ABOVE the iter-6 best 0.0966 (breast-CT TPE precedent: wu hr0.317 at ~10x-lower lr suggests gentler-lr headroom IF converged). BUDGET (HARD 20-min/1200s train+score; sbatch --time=00:30:00): vn_T=1 = ~0.5x iter-7 vn_T=2 per-step DC+RBF cost -> the LIGHTEST/FASTEST footprint yet; iter-7 ran 971.2s total at vn_T=2, so vn_T=1 trains faster and max_train_s=1000 still binds the train wall with MORE epochs (well past the ep3 convergence point -> fair converged comparison). train_n=480 kept (the iter-5/7 data-coverage setting), val_n=214 kept. DATA-COVERAGE lever on the BOARD CHAMPION. ONE KNOB: train_n 400->579 (FULL 579-slice train pool, ~69%->100% coverage), with pretrain_epochs traded 120->72 + pretrain_patience tracked 120->72 (early-stop stays disabled) to HOLD the HARD 1200s wall AND keep grad-step parity train_n*epochs (iter-7 400*120=48000; iter-8 579*72=41688, ~13% fewer steps as a budget-safety margin since iter-7 overran at 1308.6s). Base=iter-7 (the BREAKOUT, NEW #1, SSIM 0.9414/hr 0.4187 @itnet_k=1/tn400/ep120). KEEP itnet_k=1 (the iter-7 breakout) and residual_learning=False (the mandatory config-fix). MECHANISM (campaign_state.md, CONFIRMED): build_dataset calls load_val_split(split='train', n=train_n) -> a FIXED n-slice subset loaded ONCE; pretrain_denoiser merely reshuffles that subset each epoch (torch.randperm), NO RotatingSubsetDataset. So train_n=400 lets the denoiser see only ~69% of the 579-slice pool (3 ps-groups: 154@0.66192, 98@0.73979, 327@0.77873); train_n=579 raises coverage to 100%. This is the SAME confirmed lever that lifted uswin (200->480, hr 0.3532->0.3829, +0.0297) and itnet_v3 (200->400, hr 0.3123->0.3288, +0.0165) and itnet v1 (200->300). CURRENT train_n=400 (~69% of 579 pool). (2) LIMITER: with itnet_k=1 unlocked, the binding limiter is now the TRAINED DENOISER's data coverage -- it only sees ~69% of the anatomy in the 579-slice pool because the fixed-subset loader never rotates. The single trained-denoiser+1-DC pass is excellent (0.9414) but the denoiser is data-coverage-limited, the proven climb lever for the end-to-end/denoiser trainers this campaign. (3) ONE KNOB: train_n 400->579 (full pool), pretrain_epochs traded 120->72 to hold budget; itnet_k=1 KEPT, residual_learning=False KEPT. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if train_n 400->579, val_ssim/hr rises ABOVE iter-7 0.4187 because the denoiser sees 100% vs 69% of the 579-slice anatomical variety at near-equal optimization, exactly as full-coverage lifted uswin/itnet_v3/v1. NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if hr <= 0.4187 (flat/down) at train_n=579, the denoiser is NOT data-coverage-limited at k=1 -- coverage is exhausted -- and iter-9 reverts to tn400 and probes pretrain_epochs UP (more denoiser convergence) as the next lever. (5) BUDGET: HARD 20-min (1200s) train+score. iter-7 per-epoch at tn400/k1 ~8.31s/epoch, fixed (214-slice per-sample val + figure) ~312s (1308.6 - 120*8.31). BEST SSIM 0.8185 (iter-6); hr=0.0 EVERY iter. MAPPED KNOBS: tv_step_init bracketed {1e-2 saturate, 1e-8 passthrough, 1e-5 active-basin}; tv_share_steps {F runaway, T stable}; tv_lr {5e-2 over-drives, 5e-3 stable}; tv_K raised 10->30 ONLY at the FROZEN-step regime (iter-1/2, where it was provably inert). LIMITER: iter-6 sits EXACTLY at the LD-FBP passthrough floor (0.8185 ~= the 0.8137/~0.81 floor) -> the trained K=30 GD with the settled small-lambda is a near-identity map on fbp_init that neither helps NOR hurts. This campaign overturned FOUR assumed ceilings via a single untried lever, and TWICE that lever was unroll-DEPTH-DOWN (itnet itnet_k 3->1, hammernik_vn vn_T 5->2). The TV analog (tv_K DOWN) has NEVER been run at a regime where training is stable. ONE KNOB CHANGED (from BASE_ITER=6): tv_K 30 -> 8 (depth-DOWN, the genuinely-untried structural lever). All else IDENTICAL to iter-6 (tv_share_steps=True, tv_step_init=1e-5, tv_lr=5e-3, tv_lambda_init=1e-3, train_n=40, epochs=8, bs=1, tv_clip_max=0.05, tv_eps=1e-6, val_n=214 ALL L277, val_chunk=5, grad_clip=1.0). HYPOTHESIS: with FEWER unrolled GD steps the cumulative TV smoothing is reduced, so the supervised optimizer can fit a SHARPER trained step/lambda that applies a few targeted data-consistency corrections while staying closer to the sharp FBP init -- if supervised-TV has ANY headroom above its own FBP, a shallow unroll is structurally where it would surface (mirroring the itnet/hammernik_vn depth-DOWN breakouts), lifting SSIM ABOVE 0.8185 and clearing hr>0. NUMERIC FALSIFIER (decisive): if SSIM stays <= 0.8185 with hr=0.0 at K=8, depth-DOWN is exhausted at the stable regime -> the LAST structural lever is retired and supervised-unrolled-TV is CONFIRMED FBP-bounded on real Mayo 2304-view LDCT under the config-only contract (the shared solvers raw unnormalized-adjoint back_project step is FORBIDDEN to edit) -> file the NEGATIVE RESULT and STOP at iter-7. BUDGET (HARD 20-min train+score = 1200s): tv_K 30->8 STRICTLY LOWERS compute (fewer unroll steps per train+val pass; fixed overhead = data load + 214-slice FBP precompute dominates) -> WELL under iter-6 measured 911.5s, comfortable margin under the 1200s wall; sbatch --time=00:30:00 carries figure/IO headroom. PREDICTED iter-7: SSIM ~0.80-0.86, hr most-likely 0.0 (a single global TV weight over a near-complete inverse is a structurally weak image-domain prior on real LDCT noise, regardless of depth); small chance hr 0.0-0.05 if shallow depth lets a sharper trained step beat the passthrough.

rationale: fast-diffusion recon (pixel domain, unconstrained prior): per-image few-step DC-guided reconstruction from a trained fast-diffusion prior (solver_fast_recon.py, 8-step, FBP init @ t=0.7, eta=1.0, DC=1 CG=5). The 'unconstrained' prior was trained on the larger Mayo train slice pool (vs the 50-slice constrained prior); 'unconstrained' is a misnomer inherited from the demo-dl phantom regime and means MORE train slices, NOT GT leakage (train split only; no val/test). Evaluated on ALL 214 L277 Mayo val slices under the calibrated-SSIM-headroom metric (baseline LD-FBP SSIM 0.8147 / PSNR 34.08 dB; oracle HD-FBP). Result: SSIM 0.8745, PSNR 31.20 dB, calibrated headroom 0.0000. Honest negative on headroom: SSIM clears LD-FBP (0.8147) but the RMSE/PSNR-sensitive calibrated metric keeps PSNR (31.20 dB) below the LD-FBP floor (34.08 dB) on dense (2304-view) rebinned Mayo -> hr pinned at 0.0 (FBP-bounded, below-baseline). Cluster eval run: recon-fast-diffusion-pixel_unconstrained-766045; checkpoint /cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_pixel_unconstrained.pt (final_val_flow_loss 0.0162).
advice_for_others: fast-diffusion pixel/unconstrained: on dense full-view Mayo, an 8-step diffusion-prior recon clears FBP on SSIM (0.8745 > 0.8147) but stays PSNR/RMSE-bounded below the LD-FBP floor on the calibrated metric -> hr 0.0; the larger 'unconstrained' train pool lifts SSIM ~0.013 over the constrained prior (0.8615) but does NOT clear the FBP headroom floor on this dense-view geometry.

Current cfg = iter-6 hash: encoding=hash, hash_levels=16, feat_dim=2, log2_size=19, base_res=16, max_res=512, hidden=32, layers=3, lr=2e-2, n_iter=3000(cap), per_scene_s=5.0, outer_wall_s=1080, val_n=214. Isolates: is the small MLP under-decoding the hash feature on dense Mayo? (4) HYPOTHESIS: if naf_hidden 32->64, SSIM rises above 0.6715 because a wider MLP decodes the 32-dim multi-res hash feature more expressively within the same per-scene step budget. (5) SIZE to HARD 1200s budget: 214-scene pass, outer_wall_s=1080 (18-min in-solver outer wall = governor) + per_scene_s=5.0 (in-solver per-scene wall; n_iter=3000 stays a HIGH CAP so the WALL governs). STEP COUNT KEPT at iter-6 value (per_scene_s 5.0, n_iter cap 3000 UNCHANGED -- raising it is the DEFERRED B-fix; I did NOT touch it). 214x5.0s=1070s ~= 1080s outer wall (hit ~scene 214 every iter; measured elapsed 1094-1101s, inside the 30-min sbatch kill). The hidden 32->64 change is ~free on the wall. val_n=214 (ALL L277 slices), staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps (inlined single-val-ps probe -> L277 native ps ~0.73979), bg_target=truth, 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov= override), naf_encoding=hash kept. (6) no control return; the loop dispatches the next iter.
